newsitem.title: USA: Gander Mountain shareholders back plan.
newsitem.headline: Gander Mountain shareholders back plan.

text.p: Gander Mountain Inc said Wednesday it filed a ballot report with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Milwaukee showing shareholders and creditors support the company's reorganization plan.
The court will be asked to give final approval on Thursday, the company said.

About 99 percent of the creditors and about 89 percent of the common shares and all of the preferred shares voted to approve the plan, which is sufficient to satisfy the requirements of the Bankruptcy Code, the company said. The Court must determine whether it meets the other requirements.

Under the terms, the company's twelve retail stores and substantially all related assets of the business will be transferred to Holiday Cos which will pay a purchase price equal to all secured debt, administrative expenses of the bankruptcy, priority claims, reasonable post-confirmation expenses, plus $19.5 million.
